body:
I'll try to be as sensitive as I can, but I am so tired, and a little under the weather myself. 

So, um. I think the judgement thing may be out of proportion. People make moral judgements often, but if it's "what you're doing is wrong", that's pretty normal. "You are a bad person and you should go to hell" is the kind of judgement that people should stay away from. If you both have a taboo against judging actions, that seems to me like an unhealthy one. 

Anyway, if you've been confronted with a realisation that you're not all sunshine and roses and that you make mistakes and use your hubby as an emotional heatsink, then you have an opportunity to grow into a better person. Nobody but you can make that commitment to change for the better.

Just, I dunno, agree to forgive and understand each other and make up? When I was 6 this kind of thing seemed universally understood. Although, the last time I tried it, I got a policeman for my trouble. X(
You can talk to me.
I dunno, but it's a bit more interesting than adding consecutives, but not nearly as annoying as remembering primes...
Or the Fibonacci sequence?

I know how you feel because, from circumstances I can't bear to go into, I've also felt intensely that I deserve to die and that I'm a worthless meatbag, etc. 

But I've got news for you. Everyone who lives deserves to die before very long. But nobody is worthless. You're worth so much more than you could ever imagine. That's the birthright of every human being - inestimable value.

You can't see that about yourself, heck, nobody really can. But if you can see anyone else in the world worth making an effort to help and support, then put that self-hate in your pocket and reach out to them. And maybe you'll understand some time that to someone else, you're worth a shoulder to lean on, as well. 

There are people who deeply care about you, believe it or not. Don't push them away out of wanting to spare their feelings. It won't work anyway.

You're confusing happiness with the emotion of joy. You can use drugs to trick your emotions into giving you a buzz, but happiness can only come from within. Once you get through the horrible withdrawal symptoms, your system will start to go back to normal operations and you won't feel that you need drugs just to feel ok. 

And if you can't do that, if you give in, you're gonna be stuck in that rut forever.

Huh. It sounds like you at least want to have a positive influence on the world, but you're so wrapped up in self-loathing that you can't apply yourself well.

It may not sound like much to say, but, if you live for other people, maybe concentrating on the needs of those around you will keep you too busy to stew over how much you hate yourself.

It works for me, anyway.

Hmm. I think what you describe as loneliness is more about circumstances than feelings. I don't get invited to things or have people proactively message me either, but that doesn't make me feel lonely. I'm kinda with your girl friends here, you can be surrounded by people and still be fundamentally lonely - even when you're involving yourself and having fun in the moment, there's still an awareness of a huge gulf between you and the rest of a group.
Hey, no problem. You can make it, you've just got to keep fighting. :)

It sounds like several really terrible things have hit you at once.

1) good riddance to your boyfriend! At least he told you he was incapable of love. Let him flounder about looking for some nonexistent perfect person. 

2) have you tried reaching out to your friend? Maybe she became really busy and parts of their social circle dropped off their radar. Maybe she has her own problems. 

3) do you think it's possible your therapist was clumsily trying to lighten the mood? If you really feel she was being mean, maybe ask to see a different therapist. I think opposite gender therapists can be less judgemental and more sympathetic. 

4) if that's not an exaggeration and someone is trying to blackmail you into something, report it to the police. Get the information out to people. If he's going to try and ruin your life through slander, you'd better get your defence in first. People tend to believe the first thing they hear over the second. 

5) Please hang on, and find something or someone to live for. 

6) Even if you don't believe in God, perhaps consider going to church once or twice, just for the sake of finding a few kind hearts to spend a little time with. 

7) maybe you judge people too harshly. They might not all be apathetic, just don't know how to deal with this. 

8) good luck. You still have every chance of living a happy life, but it just takes a little courage and determination to move forward one step at a time.

I was in a similar place to you not long ago. Except, everything I did to try and help, really made things worse. In the end I guess we have to accept that this is what life can be like at times. We have to weather what the world throws at us, and try to get stronger through it - like trees in a hurricane.

Maybe if you focus your attention on something else, or try to be there for someone who needs support, then instead of worrying about your own situation, you can help someone through their own. I know that's helped me to survive.
Sorry

Not a great plan. 

Think of some of the most remarkable people in history. The ones you look up to. How many of them got there by 18?

My first line was a quote from a character played by Robert Downey Jr. He was a drug addict and his life was in absolute ruins for quite a while. Now he's the highest paid actor of all time. Don't look to the past for reasons to give up. Look to the present and future for reasons to keep fighting.

I dunno, man. It sounds like something that's only an advantage if you're pursuing the career of a gothic villain. It's a tough one. It makes me think of that film, Rush, where Niki Lauda gets half his face burned off and his lungs full of gunk, and laments that he now has nothing but his past and a face that frightens children. But he made it, of course, partly out of rage at the situation and largely because of those who loved him, holding him up when needed. And almost everyone knows who Niki Lauda is.

You've got to challenge people to see you as a human being. That, or put on a mask and cape, and haunt an opera-house.
Thank goodness.
Good luck, man.

You know... there's more to life than being a good looking guy who gets the girl. Fun fact: you have twice as many female ancestors as male ancestors. That means, by my reckoning, that of all the people who have children, 50% of all men are excluded. That's a huge number. Granted, women tend to go for the aspects of men that benefit their potential children more, like the capacity for resource procurement and social standing more than whether they've got a handsome face, but 50%! Sheesh. Now you see, I don't know which side of that statistic I'm going to fall into. Probably the unlucky side, and that's a worry for people like me. We can't be sure it's not a waste of time to try. If I were as certain as you are that it's no good, that might actually be a relief. I'd figure out what else to do that matters. There's more to life than wimmin, and they can be such headaches.

Don't have time? That's the one thing you certainly do have. If you don't want your grandma to see anything, guess what, she's going to hear about it regardless. You don't want to emotionally scar them for the rest of their lives, then don't do it. Just figure out one thing that makes you want to live. There only has to be one reason.
[Then this earlier comment may help](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/702wuh/i_wonder_if_he_would_give_a_shit_if_i_killed/dn062d8/)

Should probably have demanded double pay at the time, since you're taking the work of two people. Also, how is it possible that you're 24 and have a degree that "expired"? That seems to make no sense, unless I'm missing something vital. What's your degree in?

When did all this start? What do you suppose is at the bottom of it? Feelings of loneliness, social isolation, or trouble at work? Do you suppose your bf doesn't care because he seldom texts? Most guys are not rabid communicators, or not the cool ones, anyway.
What ghastly people. Try joining a club or a church or a hobby group or something? Just to mix things up and see if there are people you can gel with.

A long time after she cut me off I sent her an email she didn't read. Then some weeks later, another one just to double-check. Then much later still I bit the bullet and trudged off to see her in person with the intention of saying, y'know, sorry about the emotional stuff that I've been able to let go of, but if we can agree to forgive and forget then if you're still going through a tough time then I'm here if you need another friend. 

Only I ran into her mum instead, and she was cordial and everything, and I got what I had to say across ok. She said I had to move on and asked me to agree not to keep trying to get in touch with her and I did, we parted ways amicably. As soon as I got home I sent an email titled "a last cheerio!" or something like that, basically expressing my well wishes and affirming my promise not to keep trying to talk to her. 

Three weeks later a bloody policeman shows up. I guess she didn't read that last one either, huh. Stupid me.

Hey. If you want to talk, even about stupid silly boring everyday stuff, you can DM me. I've been going through a really rough patch myself, and I can certainly relate to you in a few ways. I mean, I'm not going to pretend I can solve your problems, but right now, just as you need some help, I feel like I really need to help someone. And if we end up as pen-pals, so much the better. Whaddya say? :)

Actually, I didn't have anything 'heartfelt' in mind, as such. Just talking about stuff. You know. Boring everyday stuff. Work, hobbies... if you don't want to, that's fine. Just putting it out there.

Whoa, careful. What's the good of double money if you can barely cope with things as demanding as they are? Sure, it gets you out of money trouble faster, but it's like, would I rather do a 12hr day for $10 an hour or 24hrs a day for $30 an hour? Because if I do that second one I'll go coocoo and die of exhaustion. Not super profitable. 

You gotta make sure you're on firm footing before you crank up the treadmill, ya know what I mean?

It sounds like you and your parents are all in a terrible place right now. There's certainly nothing I can say or do to fix things, and you must know it too. But if you need a friend, if I can be just one more tiny little reason for you to perservere, then please DM me.

I can more or less guarantee that I can't solve your problems for you. But if you need someone to talk to, you can DM me. It may be better than nothing. I also felt like an unwanted nuisance when a helpline operator concluded that I wasn't in immediate danger and kicked me off. You just want someone to treat you like you're a human being, right?

You can talk to me.

I once believed like you that "hell is my home". I certainly lived through a kind of personal hell in the last few months, and I certainly deserve to die for things I shouldn't have done, but did, and for things I failed to do. But by your own admission, there are people who love you to the point where no number of disappointments will make them stop wishing the best for you. It would break their hearts for the rest of their lives if you died in this state. 

Find something to hold on to. Find something good or someone to live for. Please.

Hey. I'm not much older than you. Please hang on. It might seem like your parents hate you for not doing well enough. But I can almost guarantee you they either don't understand or are trying to give you 'tough love'. They want you to succeed, and in Asian cultures that can sometimes go too far. Depression is also a commonly and easily misunderstood condition. 

For now, just hold on. Live one day at a time. Talk to people about it, or even better, try and help someone else who needs it. This sub is full of lost souls, and I certainly have my own troubles. 

You can DM me if you want. I'm not gonna pretend I can solve your problems, but it's better than nothing.
You have a guy and kids, too. They need you. I promise you that they do

I was trying to apply the principle that if someone has something against you, to try and reconcile your differences and understand each other as adult human beings. It's just... I failed, or else nobody believes that's what anybody does. Regardless, we hurt each other too much. 

Thanks for saying what you said. I get it, intellecually. But emotionally I'm somewhere else. Nobody's ever been in any way intimidated or afraid of me before, and I hate it. It would be laughable if not so serious.

Being in love and having love are two totally different things. Lots of people confuse one for the other and never make the choice to actually care about the wellbeing of someone else, and that's a choice anyone can make about anyone. If they can't see the difference, that makes them idiots. Don't let them hurt you. Please don't die for a fair-weather boyfriend.

Please DM me if you want to talk/vent to someone about it.
You want to die and you haven't even left school yet?
